Microsoft Unveils Major Restructuring Amidst Financial Slump

Microsoft has announced significant job cuts as part of a restructuring effort aimed at simplifying its operations and redirecting resources towards larger projects. The company's shares have slumped nearly 23% in the first six months of 2026, its worst performance since 2022.
